name: The Muppet Show: Backstage Rampage
summary:
Oh-oh. Dr. Bunsen Honeydew’s latest experiment has gone haywire.

Combining “Chemical A” with “Chemical F” was definitely not his best ever idea, and has resulted in the entire downtown Theatre being filled with an invisible Gas - which has temporarily turned all the Security Staff barmy!

Thinking they were acting in The Muppets best interests, the Security Staff have spent the entire day combing the Theatre, locking up the whole Muppet Troupe - to keep them out of harm’s way. But now they’re refusing to let them out!

And with the Muppets Homecoming Premiere Show due to begin tonight, time is precious. Disaster - with no Muppets there can surely be no Show!

So far, though, the fabulous Miss Piggy has evaded capture. Her mission - to free as many Muppets as possible so that the Show can go on as planned. With her currently Top Billing she is determined to succeed!

Take control of Miss Piggy and battle your way past legions of Security Staff across the variety of Stages found throughout the enormous downtown Theatre. Locate and rescue Kermit The Frog so that he can, as usual, ensure the Show opens as planned!

“Muppets” is exclusive to Sky Games.
